data.text: Noida, Uttar Pradesh: Ahead of Christmas and New Year, DCP Traffic Praveen Ranjan Singh says, "During Christmas and New Year, people tend to violate rules frequently. Keeping this in mind, We are fully prepared and have issued a traffic advisory for December 25, anticipating heavy crowds at the city’s major markets, malls, and churches on the occasion of Christmas. Traffic pressure is expected to increase particularly around Sector-18, Atta Market, and major mall areas. Heavy crowds may gather near various malls. Over 300 traffic police personnel will be deployed tomorrow, and a "drunk and drive" campaign will be conducted at night against those driving under the influence of alcohol..."
